mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zw_student (STUDENT_ID, USER_ID, SEX, STUDENT_CODE, EMAIL, STUDENT_STATUS, STUDENT_TYPE, PHONE, GRA, CLA) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{userId}, #{sex}, #{studentCode}, #{email}, #{studentStatus}, #{studentType}, #{phone}, #{gra}, #{cla})
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, u.USER_NAME, u.NAME, sex.CODE_DESC as SEX_DESC, ss.CODE_DESC as STUDENT_STATUS_DESC, st.CODE_DESC as STUDENT_TYPE_DESC FROM zw_student s LEFT JOIN g_user u ON s.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sex ON s.SEX = sex.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code ss ON s.STUDENT_STATUS = ss.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code st ON s.STUDENT_TYPE = st.CODE_ID WHERE s.STUDENT_ID = #{studentId}

SELECT s.*, u.USER_NAME, u.NAME, sex.CODE_DESC as SEX_DESC, ss.CODE_DESC as STUDENT_STATUS_DESC, st.CODE_DESC as STUDENT_TYPE_DESC FROM zw_student s LEFT JOIN g_user u ON s.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN g_code sex ON s.SEX = sex.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code ss ON s.STUDENT_STATUS = ss.CODE_ID LEFT JOIN g_code st ON s.STUDENT_TYPE = st.CODE_ID ORDER BY u.USER_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO g_user (USER_ID, USER_NAME, PASSWORD, NAME, USER_STATUS, ROLE, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT, LOCK_TIME) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userName}, #{password}, #{name}, 10001001, 14981001, 0, null)
mapper.select: SELECT STUDENT_ID FROM zw_student WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
